dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters are visible on a dark dorsal surface. The borders are thin and high-contrast, often merging into complex chain-like structures along the mid-dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity clusters lacking dark centers. These are primarily located in the inter-annular spaces and become more frequent and smaller towards the posterior of the visible torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of four prominent rings on the central dorsal region form a distorted kite-like polygon. A separate triad of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a narrow acute triangle on the lower lateral flank.
